name: Paper & Paint of the World
subtitle: Alebrije painting & more
shortDescription: 20 craft traditions to play: Alebrije painting, Chinese knotting, Temari thread-ball patterns and Kumiko lattice.
longDescription:
Paper & Paint of the World: 20 craft traditions from 14 countries, in one app that works fully offline.

Inside: Alebrije painting, Chinese knotting, Temari thread-ball patterns, Kumiko lattice, Shibori indigo fold, Matryoshka, Khokhloma pattern painting, Macau wave pavement, Mashrabiya Lattice Joinery, Truck art panel, Warli painting, Block printing, Lippan kaam mud-and-mirror relief, Mehndi Henna Pattern Drawing, Ndebele geometric wall painting, Bogolan mud cloth, Zulu beadwork, Kuba raffia cloth, Adinkra cloth stamping and Lukasa memory board.

Each one has a short note on where it comes from and how it is played in the real world. You can build traditional patterns and make traditional crafts, learn by watching a demonstration, and read the rules at any time.

No account needed. Works offline.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
